name: VIP-MINGLE
description: Group conversations are a fundamental yet complex form of social interaction central to human cognition and telecommunication technology. While understanding and facilitating these interactions has been a long-standing goal, findings are often isolated within specific in-person or videoconferencing settings due to a scarcity of datasets that bridge the two. We introduce VIP-MINGLE, a multimodal dataset comprising 59 hours of recordings (32 groups, 105 participants), featuring paired within-subject sessions in both settings.
